title: Backend Engineer, Subscriptions

• Real ownership, real impact. Our subscription programmes are touching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end - from the idea through production - and see your work matter at scale.

• Cross-org engineering at the frontier. Deliveroo,  DoorDash and Wolt are working together in order to align subscription experience

title: Working Student (m/w/d) CRM & Data
description:
Über Recare
Als eines der führenden deutschen HealthTech-Unternehmen gestalten wir das Entlassmanagement neu - technologiegetrieben, patientenzentriert und frei von Bürokratie. Neben unserer marktführenden SaaS-Plattform entwickeln wir KI-Lösungen, die Prozesse in Kliniken und bei Nachversorgern radikal vereinfachen, Fachkräfte entlasten und den Fokus zurück auf die Patientinnen und Patienten legen. Bereits heute vernetzen wir zwei Drittel aller deutschen Krankenhäuser mit über 650 Rehakliniken und 25.000 Pflege- und Homecare-Anbietern. Mit aktuell mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden wachsen wir weiter - und suchen Menschen mit Haltung, die das Gesundheitssystem mit uns verbessern wollen.
Das erwartet dich als unser Working Student (m/w/d) CRM & Data:

• Arbeit mit Purpose - Deine Tätigkeit hat positiven Einfluss auf Patientinnen und Patienten, ihre Angehörigen und medizinische Fachkräfte im Gesundheitswesen.

• Unternehmenskultur - Wir setzen auf flache Hierarchien, die eine hohe Performance und eine starke Teamdynamik fördern. Wir pflegen einen Umgang, der von gegenseitigem Respekt, Loyalität und Anerkennung geprägt ist, und streben gemeinsam nach unseren Zielen und erwarten das Gleiche von dir.

• Flexibilität - Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen, sowie die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten.

• Edenred-Karte - die du nach deinen Bedürfnissen nutzen kannst.

• Zusatz-Urlaubstag - Damit du deinen Geburtstag mit deinen Liebsten feiern kannst, hast du ihn frei.

Deine Rolle als Working Student (m/w/d) CRM & Data:
Als Teil unseres Revenue Operations Teams unterstützt du uns dabei, eine hohe Datenqualität in unseren zentralen Systemen sicherzustellen. Diese Rolle ist ideal für dich, wenn du erste praktische Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Daten sammeln möchtest und verstehen willst, wie datengetriebene Unternehmen arbeiten. Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung, lernst moderne Tools kennen und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Revenue-Teams.

• Du unterstützt bei der Pflege, Bereinigung und Strukturierung von Daten in unserem CRM-System (Salesforce) und stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sowie konsistente Datensätze sicher.

• Du bereitest Daten für Reports und Analysen (z. B. in Salesforce) auf und überprüfst diese vor der Nutzung auf Vollständigkeit und Qualität.

• Du identifizierst Datenlücken, Inkonsistenzen und strukturelle Probleme und unterstützt bei deren Behebung.

• Du wirkst an der Definition und Dokumentation von Datenstandards sowie Data-Hygiene-Prozessen mit.

• Du arbeitest eng mit Teams wie Sales, Marketing und Customer Success zusammen und unterstützt datengetriebene Prozesse im Arbeitsalltag.

Requirements
So stellen wir uns dich als unseren Working Student (m/w/d) CRM & Data vor:

• Du bist aktuell in einem relevanten Studiengang immatrikuliert (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Analytics).

• Du bringst erste Erfahrungen mit CRM-Systemen mit (z. B. Salesforce)

• Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Excel oder Google Sheets (z. B. Filtern, Sortieren, einfache Formeln)

• Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis für strukturierte Daten (z. B. Tabellen, Felder, Datensätze)

• Du interessierst dich für Daten und Analysen und bringst die nötige Sorgfalt sowie Konzentration für datenintensive Aufgaben mit

• Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch

• Du kommunizierst klar und arbeitest gerne mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2)

Nice-to-haves - womit du uns zusätzlich überzeugst:

• Grundkenntnisse in BI-Tools (z. B. Looker)

• Erste Berührungspunkte mit Datenbereinigung oder Datenimporten

title: Staff Software Engineer - Serverless
description:
We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Software Engineer to technically lead and build Runware ’s serverless platform. You’ll be part of a small team working closely with senior leadership to bring a new product line to market.
Runware is evolving beyond model APIs into a platform where developers can deploy models and run AI workloads without managing GPUs, servers or infrastructure. You’ll build the software layer that connects our proprietary high-performance sonic inference engine and turns complex infrastructure into a compelling developer experience.
This is a role for someone who enjoys technical leadership, hard platform problems and clean, simple systems. Your work will help enterprises, model labs and developers move from idea to production faster, then scale without needing to build and operate the infrastructure themselves.
What you’ll do

• Build the core systems behind Runware ’s serverless platform, including workload execution, routing, scheduling, isolation and scaling leveraging our inference engine

• Make it simple for developers to deploy models and run AI workloads without managing GPUs, servers, queues or infrastructure through a simple SDK interface

• Design and improve the control plane for serverless execution, including APIs, workers, lifecycle management, retries and failure handling

• Work closely with our infrastructure and ML teams to improve workload startup time, GPU utilisation, model warm-up, caching and placement

• Build observability that makes serverless workloads easy to monitor, debug and operate at scale globally

• Lead the technical design, mentor other engineers and help define the engineering standards for a new product area

Requirements

• Strong experience as a Staff Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Platform Engineer or similar

• Experience building backend services, distributed systems, developer platforms or workload orchestration systems

• Strong understanding of async processing, queues, scheduling, retries, back pressure and failure handling

• Comfortable working across APIs, control planes, workers, databases and observability systems

• Strong engineering fundamentals in one or more backend languages ideally Go

• Good judgement around trade-offs between reliability, latency, scale, cost and developer experience

• Clear communication, strong ownership and the ability to lead technical direction in a fast-moving environment

Nice to have

• Experience building serverless platforms, job execution systems, container platforms or compute orchestration systems

• Experience with GPU-backed workloads, AI/ML inference, model serving, batch processing or high-performance compute

• Familiarity with technologies such as vLLM, TensorRT, Triton, Kubernetes, Nomad or Knative

• Experience improving workload performance through batching, autoscaling, model warm-up, caching, request routing or queue management

• Experience with multi-tenant isolation, sandboxing, quotas, rate limits, resource accounting or usage-based billing

Benefits
We’re a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm, celebrate wins, and enjoy some face-to-face time. We have core hours for cooperative working and calls, but outside of that your calendar is yours. Work the hours that let you perform at your peak while also building a healthy life.
Our release cycles are fast and intense, but they’re followed by real downtime. After big pushes we expect the team to unplug, recharge, and come back ready & stronger than ever for the next leap.

•
Generous paid time off - vacation, sick days, public holidays

•
Meaningful stock options - share in the upside you create

•
Remote-first setup - work from home anywhere we can employ you

•
Flexible hours - own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks

•
Family leave - paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time

•
Company retreats - twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations

ABOUT THE ROLE

Quartermaster is building the most comprehensive real-time picture of activity on the world's oceans. We do it by placing next-generation sensing equipment aboard commercial ships and turning the global fleet itself into a living network that illuminates the maritime domain in ways legacy AIS never could. Better maritime domain awareness means safer mariners, more secure sea lanes, and an ocean that can no longer go dark. Every vessel we bring onto the network extends that picture a little further.

But the network only exists if ships join it. This role owns that mission end to end: enlisting the right vessels across every ship type and every region we operate in. This includes: finding them, winning over their owners, closing the agreements, and stewarding the relationships that keep them contributing to the picture for the long haul.

This role is also, deliberately, a building role. Today the effort is carried by a disaggregated team scattered around the world. Your job is to forge them into a world-class recruiting organization that keeps pace as the network grows from a handful of vessels today toward the thousands we intend to field over the next few years - and to make joining Quartermaster something owners and mariners want to be part of, not just a contract they sign.

- Build the machine that scales vessel recruiting. Everything from finding vessels, to qualifying and signing them as partners, to managing the long-term relationship must be engineered into a resilient, repeatable process - not heroics.

- Proactively hire for upcoming needs: Synchronize recruiting with the growth team's push and with shifting global maritime requirements, so supply is never responsible for holding coverage back.

- 0 to 1 team build out: Determine the team you need by ship type, region, stage of recruitment etc, and iterate upon as we scale.

- Create Subject matter experts in every vessel type across the team so no segment is a blind spot and our talent bar remains high as we add new teammates.

- Act as a player/coach: Hire, onboard, and hold the team to the outcomes below. At scale these are delivered through the people you build, not by you closing every deal yourself.

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO

- Identify and win the right vessels. Work from a prioritized list of high-value target vessels, reach out to their owners and operators, and sign them as fleet partners.

- Build and personally carry the relationships. Be the individual that owners, operators, and their technical managers trust, across commercial maritime markets worldwide.

- Negotiate and close the agreements.

- Pipeline capacity full: Ensure there are always enough signed, qualified vessels ready to go, so installations never stall waiting for a vessel.

OUTCOMES YOU'LL OWN

- Coverage growth. The right vessels join the network at the pace our growth plan requires.

- Running cost per vessel. Support, connectivity, and upkeep that make up the network's recurring cost base.

- Recruiting quality. A fleet weighted toward the highest-value vessels, not filler.

- The team. A recruiting organization capable of delivering all of the above at scale.

The archetype we're hiring for

We care less about maritime pedigree than about a specific kind of operator. The person we want is someone who has scaled the supply side of a marketplace from 0 to 1, launched new markets on the ground, and turned chaotic, one-off deal-making into a repeatable acquisition machine.

- Zero to one market growth. You've walked into a new city, region, or segment with no template, stood up supply on the ground, and left behind a playbook others could run.

- Built the machine, not just the deals. You've turned relationship-driven, artisanal acquisition into a measured funnel - with clear metrics, tooling, and process behind every stage.

description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description
The GuidePoint Security North Central region is seeking a skilled AI Security Engineer to join our growing AI Security Services team within the Automation and AI Practice. You will assist customers in the design, implementation, security, and operational management of generative AI security solutions - including AI governance assessments, LLM and agent security testing, shadow AI discovery, agentic workflow development, and architecture reviews.
About the North Central AI Security Practice
You will work closely with peers across multiple domains including AppSec, Cloud Security, and Identity and Access Management to deliver holistic and secure solutions adhering to industry best practices. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to the continued growth of our AI security practice and its expanding service portfolio.
Roles and Responsibilities:

•
AI Security Architecture & Assessment: Conduct secure configuration reviews and security assessments of enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Anthropic Claude Enterprise, OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot) against established control domains - including identity and provisioning, network and access enforcement, data protection and retention, and audit and compliance - identifying vulnerabilities, attack surfaces, and gaps against industry frameworks (e.g., OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS)

•
Threat Modeling for AI Systems: Lead threat modeling exercises specific to AI workloads, covering prompt injection, model inversion, data poisoning, supply chain risks, excessive agency, privilege escalation through tool chaining, and unauthorized cross-application data movement across SaaS, self-hosted, and local AI deployments

•
AI Coding Tool & Development Environment Security: Assess AI coding tools and development environments - including Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Open Code, Cursor, and MCP servers - for sandbox isolation, plugin allowlisting, secrets access, network egress controls, and CI/CD pipeline security

•
Secure AI Integration Guidance: Advise client teams on securely integrating SaaS AI services and APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) into enterprise applications, including safe handling of credentials, outputs, and user data

•
Data Security & Privacy Controls: Evaluate and recommend controls for data ingestion pipelines, RAG architectures, and vector databases to prevent unauthorized data exposure, leakage through model outputs, or non-compliant data processing - including zero data retention enforcement, sensitivity labeling, data classification, and encryption key management

•
Shadow AI Discovery: Conduct shadow AI discovery engagements to inventory unsanctioned AI tool usage and assess associated data exposure risks across client environments

•
Security Controls & Guardrails Evaluation: Evaluate security controls and guardrails across AI platforms, including identity and access management, DLP integration, conditional access policies, SIEM and logging configurations, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and AI-specific runtime protections

•
Agentic Workflow Development: Design, build, and deploy AI agent workflows including use-case design, agent architecture, and integration with security tooling and automation platforms

•
Security Architecture Reviews: Perform security architecture reviews for organizations deploying AI agents that connect to tools, data sources, or other agents via MCP or agentic frameworks, delivering reference architectures and recommendations

Waymo's Compute Team is tasked with a critical and exciting mission: We deliver the compute platform responsible for running the fully autonomous vehicle’s software stack. You will:

• Master/doctorate degree in EECS

title: Engineer II, System validation Test - Insight QA
description:
LOCATION - BANGALORE

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Engineer II in System Validation Testing with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our cloud network management quality engineering team. The role focuses on hands-on testing of a cloud-hosted platform used to onboard, configure, monitor and manage networking devices such as access points, switches and routers.

The engineer will work with senior QA engineers, developers and product teams to understand requirements, design and execute tests, automate repeatable workflows, investigate failures and contribute to reliable releases across the device, network, cloud, API and web or mobile application layers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

CLOUD NETWORK MANAGEMENT TESTING

· Understand feature requirements and expected customer workflows for cloud-managed access points, switches and routers.

· Test device onboarding, discovery, provisioning, configuration and removal workflows.

· Validate device-to-cloud communication, cloud-to-device operations and configuration synchronization.

· Test device status, statistics, alerts, notifications and basic remote-management workflows.

· Validate firmware upgrade, reconnect, recovery and factory-reset scenarios under guidance.

· Execute tests across common LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and multi-device network setups.

TEST PLANNING AND EXECUTION

· Review user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications with the QA team.

· Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions.

· Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments.

· Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests.

· Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early.

· Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows.

API CLOUD AND DATA VALIDATION

· Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries.

· Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling.

· Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces.

· Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers.

· Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures.

· Perform smoke and regression validation in QA and staging environments.

NETWORKING AND TROUBLESHOOTING

· Apply networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, DHCP, DNS, ARP, ICMP, HTTP and HTTPS, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi.

· Use ping, traceroute, nslookup or dig, iperf, browser developer tools and device or cloud logs during troubleshooting.

· Capture and perform basic analysis of network traffic using Wireshark or tcpdump.

· Isolate whether a failure is related to the device, network, cloud service, API, backend or application layer, and involve the appropriate team.

TEST AUTOMATION

· Develop and maintain Python-based automation for APIs, device workflows and regression scenarios.

· Create or update UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent framework.

· Follow existing framework standards and build reusable, readable and maintainable test components.

· Analyze automation failures, distinguish product defects from script or environment issues and fix tests within assigned scope.

· Run automated suites through CI/CD pipelines and report failures with supporting evidence.

· Identify stable, repetitive manual scenarios suitable for automation.

DEFECT MANAGEMENT AND TEAM COLLABORATION

· Log clear defects with reproducible steps, expected and actual behavior, logs, screenshots, API traces and packet captures when applicable.

· Participate in defect triage, daily stand-ups, sprint planning and test-status discussions.

· Collaborate with software, cloud, firmware, networking and mobile teams to reproduce and resolve issues.

title: Law Firm Digital Strategist
description:
Description
At Rankings.io , we help law firms grow through GEO, SEO, paid media, video, and other digital marketing services. We are looking for a Law Firm Digital Strategist to connect client objectives to clear priorities,measurable roadmaps, and coordinated work across channels. This role reports to the Chief Strategy Officer and contributes to improving our approach to client strategy.
The Account Manager owns the client relationship and ongoing communication. The Law Firm Digital Strategist owns strategic direction, the roadmap, and the analysis that informs recommendations. Channel teams own execution. This is an individual-contributor role focused on planning, analysis, and direction, without hands-on campaign management or production responsibilities. The Strategist leads strategic discussions within client meetings in partnership with the Account Manager, explains recommendations and results, and participates in occasional in-person meetings.
Responsibilities
Client Objective Translation and Roadmap Ownership

• Assess each client’s market, competitive position, desired case mix, geographic priorities, and budget to identify opportunities and constraints.

• Partner with the Account Manager and client to establish realistic growth objectives, accounting for intake performance, firm capacity, and the time required to produce results.

• Translate objectives into measurable roadmaps covering at least three months, with priorities, milestones, KPIs, and a clear rationale for the recommended approach.

• Maintain an active roadmap for every assigned client, preparing the next segment before the current one ends. Develop longer-term plans when client goals or complexity require them.

Cross-Channel Strategy and Prioritization

• Evaluate opportunities across GEO, SEO, Local SEO, paid media, video, organic social, content, link building, CRO, creative, web, and analytics.

• Establish priorities based on expected impact, dependencies, available resources, and approved client scope and budget. Identify when additional investment or approval is needed.

• Partner with channel experts to ensure execution plans support the roadmap while allowing specialists to determine the best technical approach.

• Identify blockers and sequencing issues, challenge work that does not support client objectives, and recommend a better use of resources.

Performance Analysis and Accountability

• Interpret client performance using qualified lead volume, lead quality, acquisition costs, conversion rates,signed cases where available, and relevant channel metrics.

• Diagnose underperformance, distinguish marketing issues from tracking gaps or intake challenges, and develop corrective recommendations with the appropriate teams.

• Identify when to expand successful initiatives, shift budget or effort, pursue new growth opportunities, or change the approach.

• Escalate material risks, execution blockers, data issues, and resource constraints promptly, and follow through on agreed actions.

Internal Collaboration and Client-Facing Support

• Partner closely with Account Managers to align strategic recommendations with client priorities, expectations, and commitments.

• Lead strategic discussions with clients, explaining performance findings, recommendations, trade offs, and expected outcomes.

• Keep Account Managers, channel teams, and leadership aligned on priorities and decisions, resolving strategic disagreements constructively.

Roadmap Management and Strategic Documentation

• Complete monthly strategy checkpoints to evaluate progress, performance trends, blockers, and necessary adjustments.

• Document objectives, strategic diagnosis, priorities, timelines, KPIs, risks, and next decisions, maintaining clear records of changes and assumptions.

• Adapt planning depth to each client’s needs, balancing ongoing improvements for successful accounts with deeper analysis for complex or underperforming accounts.

• Contribute to improving planning

title: Full Stack Producer (Music Notation, Audio ML)
description:
Description
We’re looking for a musically literate specialist to help evaluate the quality of AI models working with music notation and audio. You’ll contribute to QA and data labeling across OMR, Audio2Score, and Autograde, helping improve our models and build high-quality golden datasets. Strong musical understanding, attention to detail, and the ability to evaluate musical outputs in a structured way are essential.
This role is offered on a contract basis, with the number of working hours to be discussed and agreed upon.
Key responsibilities

• Expert-score every OMR and A2S release each sprint (biweekly QA: 5-20 scores for OMR, 5-10 for A2S)

• Run deeper quarterly QA cycles with AB-tests (100-300 scores for OMR, ~100 for A2S)

• Run quarterly competitor benchmarking against N competitors on the golden dataset (first cycle planned October 2026)

• Provide fast sanity checks on model candidates between releases (5-10 scores/week for OMR when updates are available; 1-2 scores, 2-3 times/month for A2S)

• Spot-check outputs against MSCZ ground truth and flag dataset/benchmark inconsistencies

• Build and label the Autograde golden test set: record specific mistake types and annotate each recording against the score (what should have been played, what error occurred) - needed before the Oct 31, 2026 MatchMySound cutover

• Run head-to-head comparison of Autograde vs MatchMySound on the same golden set

• Extend the golden dataset by transcribing audio where possible

• Extend the same labeling/QA process to adjacent projects (AutoSync, Audio2Chords) as they scale

Requirements

• Strong musical literacy: able to read and evaluate music notation, scores, and audio performances

• Experience judging OMR (optical music recognition) and audio-to-score transcription output for accuracy

• Familiarity with structured/rubric-based QA scoring methodology

• Comfortable evaluating a range of score types (multilingual lyrics, orchestral vs. ensemble vs. solo, tabs, chord notation)

• Attention to detail for spot-checking datasets against ground truth

• Comfortable giving structured written feedback usable by engineering/product teams

title: Sr. Director, RCM
description:
About the Role
Daybreak Health delivers teletherapy to young people and families through schools, funded by health plans. As our Senior Director of Revenue Cycle Management, you will own the revenue cycle end to end, from enrollment through cash, for a payer mix that is narrow but operationally demanding: Medicaid and managed care organizations (MCOs), outpatient behavioral health, telehealth, and clinicians licensed across multiple states.
This is a build role, not a maintain role. You will inherit real gaps and be expected to close them with process and automation rather than headcount. You will report to our President and Co-Founder and lead the RCM team, which today includes an RCM Manager, a Lead Billing Specialist, and Billing Specialists. You will also partner closely with Finance, Clinical Operations, Product and Engineering, and Credentialing. You will present directly to executives and have clear line of sight into the cash you move.
We will not scale RCM by adding billing headcount in step with claim volume. We are looking for a leader who treats that as a design constraint and gets energized by it.
What You'll Own

•
AR and denials. Read an aging report, know where the money is stuck, and fix the root cause, not just the claim. You will build the habit of tracing denials and slow-pay patterns back to the workflow, payer rule, or system gap that created them.

•
Metrics and reporting. Run the function off numbers: net collection rate, days in AR, clean claim rate, denial rate, and cost to collect. Give leadership a view of collections they can trust, with definitions that hold up and reporting that does not depend on heroics.

•
Systems. Own the EHR, clearinghouse, and billing platform relationships and configuration. Find process gaps and build solutions, including working with Engineering when the fix lives in the product.

•
Front-end revenue integrity. Own real-time eligibility and benefits verification at intake, patient responsibility, and estimates. Most denials are created before the session happens. You will influence workflows you don't directly manage, particularly with Clinical Operations, and drive upstream behavior change.

•
Automation and AI leverage. Default to eliminating repetitive work. You will identify where automation and AI can take over manual billing, posting, follow-up, and reconciliation work, and put them into production with the right controls.

•
Cash forecasting. Be a credible partner to Finance at close, accruals, reserves, and AR allowance. Finance should never have to chase RCM for a number or wonder how it was built.

•
Compliance. Adolescent behavioral health billing carries real confidentiality risk in EOBs, statements, and minor-consent handling, on top of HIPAA and payer audit exposure. You will build the operating discipline that keeps us compliant as we scale.

What Success Looks Like

• Leadership, Finance, and the executive team trust the NCR numbers, know what is driving them, and see them improve!

• AR is understood by payer, age bucket, and root cause, and aged balances are moving in the right direction.

• Denial and clean claim rates improve because upstream workflows (eligibility, authorization, intake, documentation) are fixed at the source.

• Manual billing work keeps getting simpler or automated, and RCM capacity scales more slowly than claim volume.

• Finance gets forecasts, accruals, and reserve inputs on time, with clear assumptions and honest variance explanations.

• Clinical Operations and RCM work from shared definitions and a shared view of how clinical workflows affect revenue.

• Confidentiality, minor-consent, and audit-readiness practices are documented, trained, and followed.

What We're Looking For

• 10+ years in RCM, including 5+ years leading RCM teams.

• Experience in one or two startups. You have built from square one and stayed flexible as the business changed.

• Deep outpatient behavioral health and Medicaid/MCO billing expertise.

• Prac

- Helping to shape new mobile work as it expands across more of the business, including consumer monetisation and lettings.

- You have commercial experience building and shipping production apps with React Native and TypeScript, on both iOS and Android.

title: Lead Product Manager, Video Platform
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

We are hiring a Lead Product Manager for the Video Platform. You will own live streaming, historical playback, cloud backup and clip export, transcoding, third-party video ingest, and encryption of stored and exported video. Your work shows up every time someone opens a camera in Command, on a phone, through an API, or on a wall display.

You will work with backend, frontend, and mobile engineers, across every service our software touches. You will talk to customers to deliver revenue driving features and resolve video issues when playback, backup, or video quality breaks. You have shipped video products before, and know how to work with your customers and users to build a delightful playback experience.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

What You’ll Do

• Own live view and historical playback. That includes the player, the timeline, scrubbing, time to first picture, stalls, and audio that stays with the video. Web, mobile, and API all count

• Own cloud backup and clip export. Video is recorded on the camera and copied to the cloud. You decide retention, what the backup product includes, and how reliably a clip gets out when someone asks for it

• Own reliable, quality streaming experiences, even under difficult environmental conditions. Many viewers on one camera, sites on LTE or a thin uplink, and cameras that keep recording when the cloud path is down

• Own third-party video ingested via RTSP for playback in various formats and clients

• Own transcoding. A lot of recorded video is HEVC. Some clients can only play H.264. You will work with engineering on when to transcode, what it costs, and how often it fails

• Own customer-controlled encryption for stored and exported video, where the customer holds the keys

• Set engineering quality standards for playback, framing, and cloud backups. Proactively identify and resolve customer issues using core performance metrics for Quality of Service

• Work with sales, support, go-to-market, and design to deliver revenue-driving video products

What You Bring

• 6+ years as a product manager, currently at Lead or Group-level scope. You have owned a video area, not a single feature

• At least 3 years at a company whose product is video. Streaming, playback, recording, a VMS, real-time video, or video infrastructure all count

• More than one shipped product that an outside user watched live, played back, recorded, or exported

• Able to work with engineers on HLS, WebRTC, and RTSP, on H.264 and HEVC, on transcoding, on cloud recording, and on encryption

• Clear in writing and in the room, with engineers and with customers

• Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar quantitative field

• Must be willing and able to work onsite

title: Global People Compliance & ER Partner
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

Applied Intuition is looking for a Global People Compliance & ER Partner to run our employment compliance program and support case management for employee relations across the company. This is a senior individual contributor role to design what the program should be, not just execute it.

You’ll be the People team’s subject matter expert on compliance, keeping us compliant across every country and state we operate in. Most weeks the work is a known cycle - policies, audits, training, filings, and ER casework. Some weeks a new law lands or a situation doesn’t fit any existing process, and you’ll work out the answer and turn it into something repeatable. Some of this you’ll lead outright - on other work you’ll play a key supporting role in developing, implementing, or maintaining accountability.

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

Employment Compliance Program Strategy

- Build the employment compliance framework and roadmap, spanning pre-boarding through offboarding

- Audit our practices against legal requirements in each country and state we operate in, identify where we’re exposed, and own the plan to close those gaps

- Define the recurring checks that prove we’re compliant - I-9 sampling, policy attestation, training completion, pay data validation - and the schedule for running them

- Define the metrics that make compliance health visible - risk register, audit closure, training effectiveness, ER case volume

Global Policy, Records, and Governance

- Own the employee handbook and other required employment policies and templates

- Write, maintain, and communicate updated policies; managing expectations and accountability measures of all involved.

- Build the policy governance model - version control, ownership, central location

- Use AI to improve how policy is delivered and maintained, while meeting regulatory governance and privacy requirements

- Partner with regional stakeholders on local policy, and with Legal and COEs on alignment to local law

- Run the employment records program alongside the HRIS team on data privacy and governance on employee data, files, retention schedules, access controls, etc…across jurisdictions (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, local law)

- Monitor legislative change globally and translate it into updated policy and process

- Drive compliance reporting: OFCCP, gender pay gap, time and attendance, work with in-country partners for country-specific obligations

- Own the background check program

- Own People Compliance Training through our LMS (Ethena) (i.e. sexual harassment)

Employee Relations

title: GWTG-CAD Abstractor
description:
Why ADN? Join the American Data Network family and become part of an established, purpose-driven healthcare quality organization with more than 30 years of experience. At ADN, our work supports hospitals and healthcare clients in improving quality, patient safety, and clinical outcomes. We value integrity, accuracy, collaboration, and professionalism, and we are looking for experienced abstractors who take pride in producing high-quality work.
Position Summary: American Data Network is seeking experienced GWTG-CAD Registry Abstractors to support accurate and timely cardiovascular registry abstraction for assigned healthcare clients. This role is ideal for candidates with recent, hands-on GWTG-CAD abstraction experience who can independently review clinical documentation, apply registry specifications, and meet assigned deadlines with a high level of accuracy.
This is not a general data entry position. Candidates must have direct healthcare registry, clinical chart review, quality reporting, or data abstraction experience specific to GWTG-CAD.
Position Details: ADN hires both contractors and full-time employees for Data Abstraction roles. Contractors must be available for a minimum of 15 hours per week.
Key Responsibilities:

• Reviews patient medical records and abstracts data for the GWTG-CAD Registry.

• Applies registry specifications, definitions, inclusion and exclusion criteria, and abstraction guidelines accurately and consistently.

• Interprets clinical documentation related to cardiac catheterization, PCI procedures, diagnoses, treatments, outcomes, complications, and related quality measures.

• Enters accurate and complete data into assigned registry platforms, EHRs, vendor tools, or other data collection systems.

• Maintains a high level of abstraction accuracy, completeness, and attention to detail.

• Meets assigned productivity expectations, weekly progress goals, and internal and client deadlines.

• Participates in quality assurance activities, including feedback, correction, validation, and IRR reviews.

• Communicates professionally with account leads, team members, and client contacts when clarification is needed.

• Maintains strict confidentiality and complies with ADN, client, HIPAA, and data security requirements.

Qualifications:
Required:

• At least 2 years of recent GWTG-CAD Registry abstraction experience.

• Ability to independently abstract GWTG-CAD cases using registry specifications and clinical documentation.

• Strong understanding of healthcare quality reporting, registry abstraction, clinical documentation review, and medical record interpretation.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through.

• Comfort working in multiple EHRs, registry platforms, vendor tools, and data collection systems as assigned.

• Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.

• Contractors must have high-speed, secure internet, a PC or laptop, and at least two monitors.

Preferred:

• Experience using the GWTG registry platform, GWTG-CAD abstraction tools, vendor platforms, quality reporting systems, and/or related data collection tools.

• Experience with IRR, QA review, audit validation, and/or abstraction accuracy review.

Screening & Onboarding: Qualified candidates will complete an initial phone screen and a GWTG-CAD specific abstraction assessment. The assessment is designed to evaluate understanding of registry specifications, abstraction judgment, accuracy, and completion speed.
ADN does not provide basic GWTG-CAD abstraction training, so candidates should already have the registry experience needed for the role. After hire, ADN provides onboarding to ADN processes, client systems, EHR access, documentation tendencies, and other client-specific workflows.

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.
